purpose: Show how little the ASR choice matters and how much the sentiment model matters: macro-F1 on the 1,500-clip test slice for every ASR x sentiment configuration, with 95% bootstrap confidence intervals.
encodings: grouped bars: one group per ASR model (AventIQ, s2t-small, whisper-tiny), one bar per sentiment model in fixed order cardiff, distilbert, siebert, tabularisai; error bars from the CI columns; a dashed horizontal line at the always-neutral baseline macro-F1 0.2826 (Milestone2/T1_final/results/baseline.json, key macro_f1), labelled 'always-neutral baseline'

axes.y: macro-F1 over negative / neutral / positive (test slice, n = 1,500)

caption: Macro-F1 of each speech-to-text x sentiment pair on the test slice. Swapping the speech model moves Cardiff by about 0.02; swapping the sentiment model moves it by about 0.3. Error bars: 95% bootstrap CI (10,000 resamples).
